column1: # Where the verses of the Greek additions in the church's Esther stand in the frame.
# GeezVerseMap.tsv read each addition against the one row the frame then gathered it at (Ge'ez 1:1-17 at 1:1).
# The frame now gives every verse of an addition its own row (Swete's 1:1a is 11:2, his 8:1a is 16:1), so these
# lines say where each Ge'ez verse stands, read against Swete and Brenton by Claude, a language model
# (claude-opus-5-5), on 2026-11-01. They place the verses only: which verses the aligner and the verse links read
# together stays GeezVerseMap.tsv's, because a change there trains every pair the Ge'ez is aligned in again.
# The dream of Mordecai, one verse against one.
# The king's first letter. Ge'ez 4:13 is the Hebrew's 3:13, the couriers.
# The prayers of Mordecai and Esther. Ge'ez 5:15 is the Hebrew's 4:17.
# Esther before the king, in longer verses than the Greek's. The Ge'ez has nothing for 15:11.
# The king's second letter. Ge'ez 10:7-8 together are 16:7, and 10:9 holds 16:8-9.
# Mordecai's dream explained, and the note on the book. Ge'ez 12:9-10 together are 10:9.
